text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans have piled into the stands to see today's big G1 race, the Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder is determined to prove that she's more than Maruzensky's "Successor," and will reach the top herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this purpose in mind, she heads for the track.
